skill.name: update-docs
skill.description: Update all documentation in .plans, CLAUDE.md files, docs, and .tasks to match current codebase state. Use when user asks to update docs, refresh documentation, sync docs with code, or validate documentation accuracy.
skill.summary: Refresh project documentation against the current codebase while preserving important historical context.
skill.author: Cygnusfear

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by markdown code fences, inline code formatting, Mermaid examples, and prose references to documentation paths. I found no evidence of executable shell backticks, command injection, prompt injection, credential access, or data exfiltration intent in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: - Use `git log` to understand what changed
Plans in `.plans/` require careful status tracking:
- **Todo** (rename to `*.todo.md`): Plan not yet implemented or partially implemented
- **Done** (rename to `*.done.md`): Plan completely implemented and verified
- **Obsolete** (rename to `*.obsolete.md`): Plan no longer relevant or superseded
**When updating documentation, add or update Mermaid diagrams to visualize complex concepts.**

content.value_statement: Outdated documentation slows reviews and creates wrong project assumptions. This skill audits docs against the codebase and preserves important context while making factual updates.
actual_capabilities: Finds documentation in .plans, CLAUDE.md, docs, and .tasks paths.
Compares documented behavior with current codebase evidence.
Preserves architecture decisions, warnings, gotchas, and historical context.
Updates factual content such as paths, status markers, links, and examples.
Classifies plan documents as todo, done, or obsolete based on verified implementation.
Produces a change summary with files updated, preserved sections, and coverage gaps.
limitations: It depends on readable project files and accurate codebase access.
It should not rewrite decision history without human approval.
It cannot prove external links are correct without network access or a link checker.
Large documentation sets may require multiple review passes.

use_cases.title: Prepare Release Documentation
use_cases.description: Refresh docs before a release so current features, paths, and status notes match implemented code.

use_cases.title: Validate Implementation Plans
use_cases.description: Review plan files after development and update their status only when implementation evidence is complete.

use_cases.title: Protect Project Knowledge
use_cases.description: Update architecture and onboarding docs while preserving decisions, warnings, and hard-won project guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Refresh Basic Docs
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a small documentation update.
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the documentation in docs so it matches the current codebase. Preserve useful context and summarize every change.

prompt_templates.title: Review Plan Status
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for project plan maintenance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review .plans and classify each plan from code evidence. Keep unfinished work as todo when evidence is incomplete.

prompt_templates.title: Sync Project Guidance
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for sensitive guidance files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit CLAUDE.md and architecture documentation against the codebase. Preserve decisions and warnings, and ask before changing rationale.

prompt_templates.title: Run Full Documentation Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a complete repository documentation pass.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find documentation in .plans, CLAUDE.md, docs, and .tasks. Compare it with recent code changes, update safe factual content, record preservation decisions, and produce a change summary.

output_examples.input: Update docs after the new billing flow landed.
output: Reviewed billing docs and compared them with the current flow.
Updated stale path references and added missing setup notes.
Preserved the migration warning because it explains a production risk.

output_examples.input: Check whether the authentication plan is done.
output: Verified completed plan items against implementation evidence.
Marked implemented items as complete and left uncertain items as todo.
Recorded the files checked and the reason for each status decision.

output_examples.input: Refresh CLAUDE.md without losing project conventions.
output: Identified conventions, warnings, and decision rationale before editing.
Updated factual references while preserving guidance sections.
Listed all preserved sections in the final summary.

best_practices: Read important docs fully before editing them.
Verify every factual update against current code or git history.
Preserve rationale, warnings, and historical notes unless a human approves changes.
anti_patterns: Do not replace long explanatory sections with generated summaries.
Do not mark plans as done without complete implementation evidence.
Do not remove deprecated guidance unless it is clearly obsolete and approved.

faq.question: What documentation does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets .plans, CLAUDE.md files, docs, .tasks, and other documentation paths named by the user.

faq.question: Does it edit source code?
faq.answer: No. It reads source code to verify documentation and focuses edits on documentation files.

faq.question: How does it avoid deleting important context?
faq.answer: It requires a preservation pass before edits and keeps decisions, warnings, gotchas, and historical notes.

faq.question: Can it update plan statuses?
faq.answer: Yes. It marks plan status only after checking each item against actual implementation evidence.

faq.question: Does it support Mermaid diagrams?
faq.answer: Yes. It can add or update Mermaid diagrams when diagrams help explain architecture, APIs, or workflows.

faq.question: Is this useful with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow is written for agentic documentation updates and supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
